banner: Sealed preregistration — v4 floors plus the three Week-0 numbers the freeze-candidate still left as placeholders. The six-week clock has NOT started and starts only when the first Week 1 snapshot job is kicked.

floors.absolute_hit_at_1_rule: No separate absolute hit@1 floor. The paired CI lower bound >0 and point uplift >= +10pp are the hit@1 gates.

decision_rules.reserved_revision_week: One taxonomy revision slot (week 7): a stability miss invokes it once with fresh labels and a re-gate; a second miss ends the MVP with the analysis as the deliverable.
decision_rules.value_gate: At least 50% of randomly assigned, completed, non-investigator-adjudicated investigations where the report changed or materially narrowed the next action. A stated preference or unverified acceptance counts for nothing. If investigation volume slips, apply the 50% threshold to completed investigations only (does not silently pass).
decision_rules.noisy_small_n_localization: If the point estimate clears but the 95% CI spans zero, the gate FAILS. Do not localize and do not claim uplift. No metric conditions on successful localizations only. This is the week-0 rule; week-6 judgment may not override it.
decision_rules.sealed_sets: P-blind is frozen before any tuning and scored exactly once at week 6.
